title: smime-tree: cert.rs SubjectParseError fails whole verify() if any unrelated bag cert has unencodable subject
description: bag_by_subject now uses .collect::<Result<...>>()?. Any cert in the bag whose subject DER re-encoding fails (e.g. BER-encoded or non-standard string tags) causes the entire chain walk to fail with SubjectParseError, even if that cert is not part of the signer's chain. A valid signed message with one extraneous malformed cert is rejected. Fix: skip individual unencodable certs (with a log/warning if available) rather than failing the whole operation.
